title: Jailer 2's Hindi Version Caught in Multiplex Row Over Four-Week OTT Window
excerpt: Trade reports say PVR INOX and Cinepolis will skip the Hindi version because its streaming debut comes four weeks after release, not eight. The makers insist the Hindi theatrical release on October 15 is unchanged.
body:
• Multiple trade reports say Jailer 2's Hindi version will not screen at PVR INOX and Cinepolis, India's two biggest multiplex chains, and will play mainly on single screens in the Hindi belt.
  • The sticking point is the OTT window: the film is reported to stream four weeks after release, while national chains require an eight-week gap for Hindi releases.
  • The makers have officially clarified that the Hindi version releases in theatres on October 15 as planned, distributed in North India by Pen Marudhar Entertainment — but have not publicly confirmed multiplex bookings.
  • Vijay's Leo and Rajinikanth's Coolie hit the same wall in the Hindi market over short OTT windows.

A streaming deal meets a multiplex rule

Three days before release, Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 has a Hindi-market problem. According to Variety India, Sacnilk, 123Telugu and other trade outlets, the film's Hindi version will not be screened by PVR INOX and Cinepolis because Sun Pictures has locked a streaming deal that brings the film to OTT in all languages roughly four weeks after its theatrical debut. National multiplex chains require an eight-week theatrical-to-streaming gap for Hindi releases, and they do not bend the rule — even for a Rajinikanth film.

https://x.com/AndhraBoxOffice/status/2109592679755723022

""There has been no change to the scheduled Hindi theatrical release," the statement said."

The reported outcome: in the Hindi belt, Jailer 2 would play largely on single-screen theatres, the same outcome that hit Vijay's Leo and Rajinikanth's own Coolie. Trade analysts note the pattern's cost — Telugu pan-India films that accepted the eight-week window played across national chains and posted far bigger Hindi numbers, while Tamil films repeatedly trade Hindi theatrical reach for richer, faster streaming deals.

The makers' clarification

The Jailer 2 team pushed back on the strongest version of the story — that there would be no Hindi theatrical release at all. In an official statement reported by Bollywood Hungama, the makers said the Hindi version is scheduled for a theatrical release on Thursday, October 15, 2026, alongside the other language versions, as originally planned, and that Pen Marudhar Entertainment will distribute the film in North India. "There has been no change to the scheduled Hindi theatrical release," the statement said. The clarification confirms a Hindi theatrical release; it does not, on its own, confirm listings at the two national chains.

What it means for viewers

For audiences in India, the practical advice is to check listings theatre by theatre from Wednesday: single screens and regional chains may carry the Hindi version even if the national multiplexes do not, and the streaming premiere — in every language simultaneously — is expected about four weeks later, in November. For diaspora audiences in North America, the UK and the Gulf, nothing changes: the film opens October 15, led by the Tamil version, and it is already posting major pre-sales — see Jailer 2 Advance Bookings Near Rs 40 Crore Worldwide. Read the original trade report at Variety India.
